answers.stem_only: The deciding constraint is that uploads from the data center over the Direct Connect private VIF must also reach S3 privately through the VPC. A gateway endpoint for S3 is free but cannot be used from on-premises networks, so it fails that requirement. An interface VPC endpoint (AWS PrivateLink) for S3, with an endpoint network interface in each AZ, serves both the EC2 instances and the on-premises servers privately and removes the NAT gateway data processing charges. No extra NAT gateway and no public subnets are needed.
